name: condIndepSets_iff
statement: Set (Set Ω)) (hs1 : ∀ s ∈ s1, MeasurableSet s) (hs2 : ∀ s ∈ s2, MeasurableSet s) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : CondIndepSets m' hm' s1 s2 μ ↔ ∀ (t1 t2 : Set Ω) (_ : t1 ∈ s1) (_ : t2 ∈ s2), (μ⟦t1 ∩ t2 | m'⟧) =ᵐ[μ] (μ⟦t1 | m'⟧) * (μ⟦t2 | m'⟧)

have_tree.name: hs1_eq
have_tree.type: ∀ s ∈ s1, (fun ω ↦ ENNReal.toReal (condExpKernel μ m' ω s)) =ᵐ[μ] μ⟦s | m'⟧

have_tree.name: hs2_eq
have_tree.type: ∀ s ∈ s2, (fun ω ↦ ENNReal.toReal (condExpKernel μ m' ω s)) =ᵐ[μ] μ⟦s | m'⟧
